video.title: Video: editing and repurposing
video.intro: The pipeline behind my videos runs in this order: use-local-whisper (transcribe), edit-style or longform-edit (edit), reel-captions (post text), thumbnail-generator (cover).

edit-style.what: Raw talking-head take to a finished 1080x1920 reel: layouts that switch per line, real UI and official logos, captions on every word, -14 LUFS voice, measured QA gates

longform-edit.what: Raw YouTube recording to a publish-ready video: retakes removed (last take kept), dead air tightened, mastered voice, captions throughout, chapters and description, gates on the final render

use-local-whisper.what: Local transcription with word timestamps (words.json, .txt, .srt). Nothing uploaded, no API key

reel-captions.what: Per-platform post captions for one finished video, with a checker for length, hashtags and where the CTA may go

thumbnail-generator.what: 1280x720 thumbnail: text-free background, real cutout, words added in code, checked at phone size

script-polish.what: Rewrites a script so it sounds like one person talking to one friend, with pacing checkpoints

raw-to-reel.what: Simple five-step reel edit in Claude Code (prep, cut, captions, visuals, QA). For the full engine use edit-style
raw-to-reel.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your video editor"

ready-to-film.what: Notes and voice memos to fact-checked scripts in your voice

caption-engine.what: Captions per platform in your voice, CTA matched to the video
caption-engine.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your caption writer"

content-multiplier.what: One long video into up to 30 clips and posts
content-multiplier.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your repurposing workflow"

podcast-repurpose.what: One episode transcript to clip timestamps, show notes, chapters, a newsletter and posts
podcast-repurpose.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your podcast editor"

reels-engine.what: Pointer to my reel pipeline repo (ideation, scripting, Remotion panels)
reels-engine.notes: reel: "Claude just killed the edits behind every reel"

social.title: Social: ideas, planning and channels
social.intro: Most of these came from my "Claude just killed..." reels. Each runs in five parts and nothing posts on its own: every outgoing item is a draft you approve.

viral-breakdown.what: Finds videos that beat their creator's normal by 3x, explains why, ends in a weekly top five
viral-breakdown.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your competitor research"

idea-bank.what: Outlier videos in your niche to a month of ideas you can speak to
idea-bank.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your ideas meeting"

best-time.what: Reads your analytics exports and plans what to post, where and when
best-time.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your posting schedule"

content-month.what: Pillars, then a planned, written and checked month of posts
content-month.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your content calendar"

daily-social.what: Picks today's industry story, drafts posts per platform, Friday report
daily-social.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your social media manager"

marketing-team.what: Voice guide, last month's numbers, a month plan and drafted posts
marketing-team.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your marketing team"

youtube-seo.what: Reads your channel with your YouTube API key and drafts titles for new and old videos
youtube-seo.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your SEO strategy"

comment-reply.what: Pulls YouTube comments (Data API key or paste), sorts, drafts replies, finds leads and ideas
comment-reply.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your comments section"

brand-deal-filter.what: Labels sponsor pitches, checks the brand, reads the terms, drafts replies
brand-deal-filter.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your brand deals inbox"

dm-closer.what: DM reply bank, qualifying questions and a ManyChat flow plan
dm-closer.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your DM strategy"

writing.title: Writing and voice
writing.intro: humanizer is by [blader](https://github.com/blader/humanizer), MIT, copied unchanged with credit.

humanizer.what: Strips AI writing patterns from text. By [blader](https://github.com/blader/humanizer), MIT, copied unchanged with credit

sounds-like-me.what: Learns how you write and talk, writes your voice guide, rewrites drafts
sounds-like-me.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your brand voice guide"

tweet-writer.what: X posts and threads in your voice, learned from your best posts, using formats that measured best

linkedin-writer.what: LinkedIn posts in your voice, formats ranked by measured reach

newsletter.what: A founder newsletter issue in your voice: scene, lesson, one usable thing, one CTA

launch-week.what: Sales page, launch emails and daily hooks, then a skeptic rewrites the hype
launch-week.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your launch strategy"

technical-presentations.what: Designs and red-teams technical talks and decks so they have depth, not framework cards

be-concise.what: The CLAUDE.md lines for short, answer-first replies, where they go (or Claude.ai's Instructions for Claude), with a before/after test

business.title: Business: sales, ops and decisions
business.intro: Nothing sends, deletes or posts without you. Missing data becomes a question, never a made-up number.

business-starter.what: The four parts that make Claude know your business: an about-you CLAUDE.md, a context/ folder (pricing, offers, customers), a memory file of corrections, and skills/

board-advisor.what: A brutally honest advisor: every idea gets the hard truth, steps to fix it, and a task you report back on

obsidian-brain.what: A free Obsidian vault of plain-text notes with Claude Code pointed at it: raw thoughts to clear ideas, half-finished notes finished, your originals untouched

spreadsheet-dashboard.what: Cleans a messy spreadsheet and builds a formula dashboard that updates with next month's rows, with a checker for the paste-new-rows trap and a public sample file

business-audit.what: Web search for every listing, review and mention of your business, checked against the truth, then a P1/P2/P3 fix list and drafted replies and correction requests

warm-lead.what: Cleans a lead list, researches each lead, drafts outreach and follow-ups, sorts replies

meeting-follow-up.what: After a call: verified attendee list, what was promised both ways, one owner per action, checks for replies and booked calls, then follow-up drafts. Never sends

competitor-research.what: Competitor deep dive from official sources first, every claim labelled with its evidence, ending in a claim-safe battlecard

ops-desk.what: Writes processes down, morning check, nudge drafts, Friday wrap-up
ops-desk.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your operations manager"

new-hire.what: Two-week training plan, docs-only Q&A, quizzes, progress checks
new-hire.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your onboarding process"

happy-customer.what: Sorts the support inbox, builds an answer sheet, drafts replies, flags hard cases
happy-customer.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your customer support inbox"

monday-numbers.what: Checks and compares weekly numbers, explains drops, three Monday actions
monday-numbers.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your data analyst"

no-meeting-monday.what: Updates, blockers and decisions in one Monday brief
no-meeting-monday.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your weekly meetings"

hand-it-off.what: Maps the job you hate and writes it up as your own new Claude skill
hand-it-off.notes: reel: "Claude just killed the part of your business you hate the most"

bottleneck-removal.what: Finds the process that waits on you most and turns it into a runbook
bottleneck-removal.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your business's biggest bottleneck"

founder-independence.what: Captures your head into a playbook, then decides, follows up and drafts from it
founder-independence.notes: reel: "Claude just killed the reason your business needs you in it"

hiring-replacement.what: Lead intake, onboarding, SOP tasks, weekly report, client reply drafts
hiring-replacement.notes: reel: "Claude just killed your entire hiring process"

safe-resale.what: Selling a valuable item: sold comps, net proceeds per channel as formulas, scam red flags, safe handover and shipping

website-designer.what: Claude Code + Anthropic's Frontend Design plugin + the 21st MCP: setup check, brief, one design direction, build, phone and desktop screenshot check

website-dev.what: Ships changes to a GitHub + Vercel site and proves they are live

seo-agent.what: Site-config driven SEO audit and fix loop: crawl, indexability, schema, link graph, Core Web Vitals, Search Console, fixes as PRs

llms-txt.what: Reads your site, writes an llms.txt in the llmstxt.org format, checks it with an included validator, puts it live at /llms.txt. A proposal, not a ranking guarantee

conversion-funnel-auditing.what: Audits a live funnel from ad promise to booked call or payment, with P0/P1/P2 findings

security-auditor.what: Repo security audit: secrets, dependency advisories, commit history, threat-model review, findings report

secure-credentials.what: API keys and tokens without the value ever reaching chat, logs or git: locked .env, read-only check, gitleaks, rotation checklist

linux-server-ops.what: Disk full, out of memory or runaway logs on a Linux server: measure first, safest fixes first, prevention, before and after report

repo-radar.what: Keeps a verified, deduplicated list of GitHub repos you feature, with phone-size screenshots

downloadable-asset-engineering.what: Builds reproducible ZIP downloads and verifies the released bytes

precision-pdf-editing.what: Surgical edits to an existing PDF that keep fonts, highlights and layout, with a pixel diff to prove it

html-to-pdf.what: Documents as HTML with exact page layout, rendered to PDF headless, every page checked as an image. Tested render script included
